text:
ops-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT: Canary health degrading in eu-west-1 (canary-wave-17). 5xx rate ↑ from 0.2% -> 4.8% in last 3m. Affected route: /v1/generate. Trigger: canary-health-checker.

maria: seeing 502/503 spike on canary wave-17, dashboards: https://dash.reddemo/canary/wave-17 - seems correlated with recent model rollout.

aj: which model + flags were in that wave? any quant changes?

maria: model rdlw/model-x-quantized:20240321, feature flags: tokenizer_v2=true, kv_cache_prefetch=on. Deploy finished ~5m before alerts.

tyler: taking pager — I'll coordinate. Is this customer visible / severity?

maria: yes, 2 enterprise customers experienced 503s (~7 sessions). CS flagged it. No data loss observed.

samir: quick look at proxies and hosts, grabbing logs, but I see repeated upstream resets and an OOM trace on model-host-03. Paste snippet:
```
proxy: upstream read error: connection reset by peer
2024-04-27T10:16:12Z model-host-03: inference error: kv-cache OOM at memalloc
```

emily: autoscaler didn't increase because rollout pinned min_replicas=1 for the canary. Combined with tokenizer_v2 memory reg, that explains spike. Options: rollback model, disable tokenizer_v2 flag, or increase canary replicas. Fastest is flip flag.

aj: agree — try feature-flag cut first. Anyone able to flip quickly?

tyler: I can flip and mute noisy alerts for 10m while we observe. Will do feature-flag toggle now.

tyler: `/flag set tokenizer_v2 false --env=prod --scope=canary-wave-17`

ops-bot: Command executed by tyler: feature flag tokenizer_v2 set to false for canary-wave-17.

deploy-bot: traffic controller: rolling rollback of tokenizer variant for wave-17 initiated.

maria: seeing 5xx metric drop start to show in edge within ~30s of the flag flip.

samir: re-checking logs — OOM traces stop after flag toggle, memory footprint per request down. Looks like tokenizer_v2 introduced memory regression under certain sequences.

tyler: unmuting alerts. Current 5xx back near baseline (0.25%). :white_check_mark:

emily: CS update: affected customers had errors between 10:12–10:18 UTC, CS notified customers and is following up with timeline.

aj: containment looks successful. Create an incident ticket and assign owners for postmortem and model bisect.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-20240427-582. Severity: P2. Owners: maria, samir. ETA for postmortem draft: 24h.

maria: I'll capture failing prompt samples and reproduce locally. Please do not re-enable tokenizer_v2 until we have memory regression tests and a safe rollout plan.

tyler: oncall handoff note — I'm oncall for next 30m; if anything re-spikes ping me directly. Otherwise will hand to aj at shift end.

aj: ack. Thanks all for quick response. Follow-ups: postmortem + add automated memory check to canary gating. :thumbsup:
